vulnerability_mechanism.detail: The advisory and researcher describe GET /gradio_api/file=<external URL> returning HTTP 302. PDFMathTranslate v1.9.9 imports Gradio and calls demo.launch(); Gradio tag gradio@5.29.0 mounts APIRouter(prefix='/gradio_api') and its GET/HEAD /file={path_or_url:path} handler returns RedirectResponse(url=path_or_url, status_code=302) when is_http_url_like(path_or_url). The endpoint is dependency-provided but is reachable through the launched application, so absence of a first-party route does not prove that the affected application is a false positive.

atomic_bic.detail: No PDFMathTranslate commit wrote the vulnerable redirect branch. Commit 3fad3b31d19fc9e404550878309754ff45005eec first added a Gradio GUI and app.launch(), but it is an integration commit, not the smallest writer of the dependency handler. The exact first writer must be resolved in gradio-app/gradio history, which is not the assigned clone.

immediate_parent_absence.detail: The parent a5780f68af5eaf5108e87163def99bcbec2bf3bd of PDFMathTranslate integration commit 3fad3b31d19fc9e404550878309754ff45005eec contains no Gradio import or launch, but this does not establish absence of the vulnerable RedirectResponse branch in the unknown Gradio BIC parent.

squash_member_decomposition.detail: The PDFMathTranslate integration commit is a one-parent atomic commit, not a squash aggregate. Squash/member decomposition for the actual Gradio handler writer cannot be checked without the Gradio source history.

affected_release_membership.detail: Annotated tag v1.9.9 dereferences to 8ef72df455bd9cdae2666b8e63b8d298e5e5dd78 and contains unpinned dependency 'gradio' plus multiple demo.launch() calls. The Gradio integration commit 3fad3b31d19fc9e404550878309754ff45005eec is an ancestor of v1.9.9. The live GHSA remains GitHub Reviewed and lists pdf2zh 1.9.9 as affected.

fixed_release_membership.detail: The GHSA lists no patched version. Tags v1.9.10 and v1.9.11 retain the Gradio launch; v1.9.11 changes the dependency only to gradio<5.36 for a documented white-screen issue. HEAD also retains gradio<5.36 and demo.launch(). No fixed PDFMathTranslate release was identified.

direct_fix_or_unpatched_state.detail: Bounded history searches for RedirectResponse, gradio_api, /file=, redirect, and CVE-2025-50736 find no first-party security fix. Commit 0f0618d3303d064d97e7adb77557b21236c6cee0 is a UI-compatibility pin, not a direct fix. Because the vulnerable code is dependency-owned, a direct-fix SHA cannot be assigned from this clone.

bic_only_ai_attribution.detail: AI attribution cannot be closed until the actual Gradio BIC is found and its author, committer, body, trailers, bot identity, and any reconstructable squash members are inspected. Human metadata on PDFMathTranslate integration commits is not BIC-only evidence for the redirect handler.

advisory_disposition.detail: CVE-2025-50736 is currently PUBLISHED in cvelistV5 and GHSA-pfrv-63w8-q7rq is reviewed and not withdrawn. No vendor rejection or disposition was produced. The demonstrated dependency route executes as part of the launched PDFMathTranslate application, so the primary's product-attribution argument does not establish that the advisory is wrong under AUDIT-PROTOCOL.md.

findings: The primary correctly identifies Gradio as the owner of the vulnerable 302 handler and correctly refuses to fabricate a PDFMathTranslate BIC.

The primary then overreaches from dependency ownership to FALSE_POSITIVE even though the affected v1.9.9 application launches that dependency route and both authoritative advisory records remain active.
The exact Gradio handler BIC, immediate-parent absence, squash topology, and BIC-only AI markers are not established by the assigned evidence; a closed AI/NOT_AI judgment is therefore unavailable.
The release history supports an unpatched consumer state, not a first-party direct fix: v1.9.11 and HEAD still launch Gradio while pinning gradio<5.36.

corrected_fields.ai_marker: unresolved; the actual vulnerable-line writer is in gradio-app/gradio and was not traced in the assigned clone
corrected_fields.reasoning: The open redirect mechanism is real and dependency-provided, but the active advisory's attribution to an application that launches the vulnerable route is not disproved merely because the route is absent from first-party source. Fail closed until the Gradio history supplies the atomic vulnerable-line writer, immediate-parent absence, any squash members, and BIC-only AI markers.

remaining_gap: Obtain the corresponding gradio-app/gradio history and identify the smallest commit that first added the external-URL RedirectResponse branch; verify its immediate parent, decompose any squash, inspect BIC-only AI markers, and establish affected/fixed Gradio release containment. A vendor rejection would also be required to revive the primary's false-positive disposition.
